ai.summary: OpenAI plans to offer its frontier models and Codex coding agent through Google Cloud in the coming weeks. The deal gives enterprise customers another route to access the models using existing Google Cloud purchasing and governance tools.
ai.title: OpenAI to sell its top models on Google Cloud in latest enterprise push

ai.summary: Anthropic has pitched lawmakers a draft bill that would allow the government to block a model only when it poses a foreseeable risk of at least $1 billion in damage or 50 or more deaths or serious injuries. The proposal would require testing and independent evaluations, while making a court order central to blocking a release.
ai.title: Why Anthropic's draft bill sets $1 billion threshold for AI risk

ai.summary: A draft IPO prospectus reportedly shows Anthropic recorded an $80.7 billion net loss in the first half of 2026, including a large non-cash accounting charge tied to convertible bonds. The disclosure highlights the financial complexity and scale of investment surrounding frontier AI development.
ai.title: Anthropic logged net loss of over US$80 billion in first half of 2026

ai.summary: The U.S. ordered civilian federal agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using the model, citing concerns about sensitive data and security risks. China condemned the move and said it would take measures to protect its interests.
ai.title: China says US DeepSeek ban disregards Xi-Trump consensus

ai.source: ElevenLabs, as reported by AI Daily
ai.summary: ElevenLabs announced two real-time speech-to-speech models for voice agents. The company says the Max version scored 98.8% on Big Bench Audio and responds in 0.57 seconds; these are company-reported results.
ai.title: ElevenLabs Launches Real-Time Voice AI Models With Up to 98.8% Speech Reasoning Accuracy

quantum.summary: NVIDIA and researchers at Jülich reported a full simulation of a noisy, error-correcting 104-qubit quantum computer on the JUPITER supercomputer. The classical simulation used 8,192 GPUs to study a magic-state technique; it is a modeling result, not a demonstration on quantum hardware.
quantum.title: Nvidia simulates 104-qubit fault-tolerant quantum computer on JUPITER

quantum.summary: Researchers from Rutgers, IBM and collaborators demonstrated real-time feedback on up to 100 qubits of an IBM Heron processor, repeatedly measuring and resetting qubits during a run. The work, published in Nature Physics, probes how feedback can control chaotic dynamics and is relevant to future error correction.
quantum.title: Rutgers And IBM Demonstrate Real-Time Control Across 100 Qubits

quantum.summary: Quantinuum reported that its Helios processor achieved a logical error rate of five errors per million operations in a color-code experiment. The company said increasing code size reduced logical errors substantially, an important test of whether error correction improves as systems scale.
quantum.title: Quantum error correction goes well beyond breakeven

quantum.summary: Quantum X Labs said its decoder, integrated with NVIDIA CUDA-Q QEC, produced about 12% fewer logical errors than the PyMatching baseline on Google’s publicly released hardware data at two code sizes. The company also reported smaller gains in a streaming-decoding evaluation; these are company-reported benchmark results, not an independent hardware demonstration.
quantum.title: Quantum X Labs' Decoder Delivers Lowest Logical Error Rates by integrating NVIDIA CUDA-Q QEC in Comparison to Other Decoders

quantum.summary: qBraid introduced qBraid OS, software for quantum-system operators to manage hardware and provide access to users. The announcement highlights integration with NVIDIA CUDA-Q for hybrid classical processing and error-correction decoding during quantum jobs.
quantum.title: qBraid Announces qBraid OS for Operating Quantum Computing Services

quantum.summary: NVIDIA announced that IQM is using its Ising open models for quantum-processor calibration, while SEEQC is combining Ising with NVQLink and its Digital Link technology. The announcements focus on calibration and low-latency classical–quantum connections for real-time error correction.
quantum.title: NVIDIA Open Models Advance Europe’s Sovereign Intelligence Across Industries
